title: Idioms describing people
subtitle: English Vocabulary in Use Upper-intermediate · Unit 9 · Consolidation practice

blocks.title: 1 Choose the correct meaning of each idiom.
blocks.instructions: Read the idiom in bold. Choose the meaning that best explains it.

items.prompt: She has a heart of gold.
items.exampleAnswer: She is very kind and generous.

items.prompt: He is as hard as nails.
options: He shows no sympathy for other people.

items.prompt: She is an awkward customer.
options: She is difficult to deal with.

items.prompt: He has his head screwed on.
She has her head in the clouds.
options: She is imaginative but not very realistic.
She is calm in a crisis.

items.prompt: He is a bit of an odd-ball.
options: He is top of the class.

items.prompt: She is a know-all.
options: She always gets the best marks.
She is good at remembering facts.

blocks.title: 4 Choose the idiom that best describes each situation.
blocks.instructions: Choose the idiom you would naturally use to talk about the person or behaviour.

items.prompt: Nina is kind, generous and always ready to help.
items.exampleAnswer: She has a heart of gold.

items.prompt: Mark keeps telling everyone how brilliant he is.
options: He is as good as gold.
He has his heart in the right place.

items.prompt: Elena understands money, budgets and numbers very quickly.
options: She has a head like a sieve.
She has a good head for figures.
She has her head in the clouds.

items.prompt: Sam refuses to talk about a serious problem and hopes it will disappear.
options: He is burying his head in the sand.
He is head and shoulders above everyone else.

items.prompt: Bella means well, even if she sometimes says the wrong thing.
options: Her heart is in the right place.
She is as hard as nails.

items.prompt: Oscar behaves in a very exaggerated way and makes every small problem dramatic.
options: He is top of the class.

blocks.title: 5 Choose the most natural response.
blocks.instructions: Choose the response that uses the idiom correctly and sounds natural.

items.prompt: A: I forgot my keys again. B:
items.exampleAnswer: You have a head like a sieve.

items.prompt: A: My brother keeps correcting everyone, even when he is wrong. B:
options: He sounds like a real know-all.
He sounds as good as gold.

items.prompt: A: Carla never panics, even under pressure. B:
options: She really has her head in the clouds.
She really gets on everyone’s nerves.

items.prompt: A: He has helped me every weekend since I moved house. B:
options: He has a heart of gold.
He is a nasty piece of work.

items.prompt: A: I cannot work with Mia. She complains about every tiny detail. B:
options: She sounds like an awkward customer.
She sounds like a teacher’s pet.
She sounds head and shoulders above everyone else.

items.prompt: A: Dan is miles better than the rest of the team. B:
options: He is head and shoulders above them.
He has his head in the clouds.
